description: Omgevingsverordening, Vaarwegen en Scheepsvaartklasse is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atlas.brabant.nl. File with fairway sections and shipping classes within the province of North Brabant that are classified as provincial fairway, largely based on the Top10NL. Here the management is carried out on behalf of the province by water board Brabantse Delta. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Environmental Ordinance, Waterways and Shipping Class" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
